The current billing method of the instance. Valid values:
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription.

To change to the Serverless type, you must configure the following parameters: automatic start and stop (AutoPause), scaling range (MaxCapacity and MinCapacity), and elastic policy (SwitchForce). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/411291.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/604344.html, and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607742.html

ScheduleTime: The new configurations take effect at a specified time. The specified time must be at least 12 hours later than the current time. The actual switchover time follows the rule: EffectiveTime = ScheduleTime + SwitchTime. You can allocate a specific time for the switchover

parameters.help_en:
The instance storage type. Valid values:
local_ssd: local SSD
cloud_ssd: standard SSD (not recommended because this storage type is no longer available for sale in some regions)
cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD cloud disk
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD cloud disk
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD cloud disk
general_essd: premium performance disk

Note the following items when you change the storage type:
<props="china">* If you change the instance storage type from ESSD cloud disk to premium performance disk, other parameters (such as instance type and storage capacity) must remain the same as the current values and cannot be modified.</props>

<props="china">* For MySQL or MariaDB instances with standard SSD storage, you can pass `cloud_essd` to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/314678.html. To upgrade, you must specify both DBInstanceClass and DBInstanceStorage with the same values as the current instance.</props>

<props="china">* For PostgreSQL instances, you can upgrade from standard SSD to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96750.html, but downgrading from ESSD cloud disk to standard SSD is not supported.</props>

<props="intl">For PostgreSQL instances, you can upgrade from standard SSD to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96750.html, but downgrading from ESSD cloud disk to standard SSD is not supported.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例存储类型，取值：
local_ssd：高性能本地盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘（不推荐，部分地域已经停止售卖）
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
general_essd：高性能云盘

如需变更存储类型，请注意：
<props="china">* 如果将实例存储类型由ESSD变更为高性能云盘，则其他参数（实例规格、存储空间大小等）需与实例原参数值保持一致，不允许修改。</props>

<props="china">* 对于MySQL或MariaDB实例，存储类型为SSD云盘时，您可以传入`cloud_essd`将实例的存储类型https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/314678.html。如需升级，则**DBInstanceClass**和**DBInstanceStorage**都需要传入，且需要与实例现有的值相同。</props>

<props="china">* 对于PostgreSQL实例可以将SSD云盘升级为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96750.html，但**不支持将ESSD云盘降级为SSD云盘**。</props>

<props="intl">对于PostgreSQL实例可以将SSD云盘升级为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96750.html，但**不支持将ESSD云盘降级为SSD云盘**。</props>

parameters.help_en: The time at which the specification change is performed. We recommend that you perform specification changes during off-peak hours. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). The specified time must be later than the current time (the time when the call is initiated). Otherwise, the specification change task fails. After the task fails, you must wait for the order to be automatically canceled before you can initiate the call again. If you only increase the storage capacity or change the ESSD storage type, the specification change is performed immediately after the request is submitted because it does not affect your workloads. You do not need to configure this parameter

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable forced scaling for MySQL Serverless or PostgreSQL Serverless instances. Scaling of instance RCUs usually takes effect immediately, but in some special cases (such as during large transaction execution), scaling cannot be completed immediately. In this case, you can enable this parameter to force scaling. Valid values:

true: enabled.
false (default): disabled.

After this parameter is enabled, the service may be unavailable for 30 to 120 seconds during forced scaling. Use this parameter with caution based on your actual requirements
fields.help_zh:
MySQL Serverless或PostgreSQL Serverless实例的强制弹性扩缩容。实例RCU的弹性扩缩容通常会立刻生效，但在某些特殊情况下（例如大事务执行中）无法即刻完成扩缩容，此时可开启本参数进行强制扩缩容。取值：

true：启用
false（默认值）：不启用

开启该参数后，实例进行强制扩缩容时会出现30~120秒的服务不可用，请根据实际情况谨慎使用

v1_parameters.help_en:
The instance storage type. Valid values:
local_ssd: local SSD
cloud_ssd: standard SSD (not recommended because this storage type is no longer available for sale in some regions)
cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD cloud disk
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD cloud disk
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD cloud disk
general_essd: premium performance disk

Note the following items when you change the storage type:
<props="china">* If you change the instance storage type from ESSD cloud disk to premium performance disk, other parameters (such as instance type and storage capacity) must remain the same as the current values and cannot be modified.</props>

<props="china">* For MySQL or MariaDB instances with standard SSD storage, you can pass `cloud_essd` to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/314678.html. To upgrade, you must specify both DBInstanceClass and DBInstanceStorage with the same values as the current instance.</props>

<props="china">* For PostgreSQL instances, you can upgrade from standard SSD to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96750.html, but downgrading from ESSD cloud disk to standard SSD is not supported.</props>

<props="intl">For PostgreSQL instances, you can upgrade from standard SSD to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96750.html, but downgrading from ESSD cloud disk to standard SSD is not supported.</props>
v1_parameters.help_zh:
实例存储类型，取值：
local_ssd：高性能本地盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘（不推荐，部分地域已经停止售卖）
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
general_essd：高性能云盘

如需变更存储类型，请注意：
<props="china">* 如果将实例存储类型由ESSD变更为高性能云盘，则其他参数（实例规格、存储空间大小等）需与实例原参数值保持一致，不允许修改。</props>

<props="china">* 对于MySQL或MariaDB实例，存储类型为SSD云盘时，您可以传入`cloud_essd`将实例的存储类型https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/314678.html。如需升级，则**DBInstanceClass**和**DBInstanceStorage**都需要传入，且需要与实例现有的值相同。</props>

<props="china">* 对于PostgreSQL实例可以将SSD云盘升级为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96750.html，但**不支持将ESSD云盘降级为SSD云盘**。</props>

<props="intl">对于PostgreSQL实例可以将SSD云盘升级为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96750.html，但**不支持将ESSD云盘降级为SSD云盘**。</props>

v1_parameters.help_en:
The effective period for the new configurations. Valid values:
Changing some configurations may affect the instance. Read the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96061.html carefully before you configure this parameter. We recommend that you perform this operation during off-peak hours.
Immediate (default): The new configurations take effect immediately.
MaintainTime: The new configurations take effect during the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610402.html.
ScheduleTime: The new configurations take effect at a specified time. The specified time must be at least 12 hours later than the current time. The actual switchover time follows the rule: EffectiveTime = ScheduleTime + SwitchTime. You can allocate a specific time for the switchover

ScheduleTime：指定时间切换。该时间需为当前时间12小时之后的一个时刻，且实际切换时间遵循EffectiveTime=ScheduleTime+SwitchTime
